reason: A music playback plugin for local files and NetEase Cloud Music, with Agent-controlled queues, playback, styling, and end-of-queue notifications.

summaries.zh: 用于播放本地音乐和网易云音乐，并支持智能体控制播放队列、播放器样式与播放结束通知的音乐播放器插件。
summaries.en: A music player plugin for local files and NetEase Cloud Music with Agent-controlled queues, playback, styling, and end-of-queue notifications.

capabilities: searches and streams music from NetEase Cloud Music
reads local audio metadata and lyric files
uses a user-provided NetEase Cloud Music Cookie for VIP playback
provides Agent tools for queue and playback control
modifies player CSS and UI settings
sends an Agent notification when the playback queue ends
